The title of an Imam leading the congregational prayers or a religious scholar who inspires and guides the community towards righteousness, both refer to themselves as Mueez.

It is a reminder that every believer has a responsibility to support and uplift Islam, and thus, the name becomes a source of inspiration and motivation for the bearer to become a beacon of hope and guidance in the community.
